text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The night before the JBC Classic. Having 
finished all necessary preparations—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cozy and warm, the two of us watched a 
boxing movie together with Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Aged Boxer
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, boy! Don't underestimate me. Even if 
I'm an old geezer..."

text_block_list.name: Aged Boxer
text_block_list.text:
"A dying flame burns the hottest right at 
the end. Bring it on!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh... Trainer, this is it, right 
here. So cool, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute was completely captivated and 
deeply moved. And then—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
choice_data_list: ...Alright, I get it, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They play around pretending to box like 
children. Seeing her this relaxed, there 
is nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The curtain rises. A cross-generational 
showdown against Hokko Tarumae begins.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan, Tarumae-chan. Are you 
feeling nervous?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Acute-san! I look forward to working 
with you to—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about that at all. More 
importantly, take a slow, deep breath, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're running together, it won't do 
if you're so stiff and tense, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true... Let me calm myself down 
first...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will take in every bit of your 
running with my entire body, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Both my own strength and the 
brilliance bestowed upon me by 
Falco-san...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to show it to Tarumae-chan, 
so don't go forgetting it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: All right. Umm, and then~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey now... Tarumae boy. Don't go licking 
me like that. Er, well...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Because it's blazing intensely... and it's 
hot?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I won't lick it... I've never 
done something like that before, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just as fired up as you are! Let's 
make this the best one this year!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Well, that's fine then. 
Looking forward to working with ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While showing her gentle side as a 
senior... her fighting spirit today leaves 
nothing to be desired."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What will this fierce battle against the 
incoming younger generation bring to 
Wonder Acute?
